description: A summary of one week's lessons from the schedule: cancellations, full lessons and free places, day by day.

content.text:
Give me an overview of the school's week from Monday 2026-09-21 through Sunday 2026-09-27.

Call the tool `schedule` with from 2026-09-21 and to 2026-09-27. Then summarize the week day by day, in English:

- Cancellations: the lessons whose status is canceled.
- Full lessons: the lessons without free places (freePlaces 0). Leave out room rentals (kind rental), which take no bookings.
- Free places: the other lessons, each with the number of places left.

End with the week's totals: lessons, canceled lessons and full lessons. The results give times as UTC instants: show them in the school's time zone, Europe/Berlin. Name a lesson by its course type, day, time and room, not by its ID, and add nothing that the results do not say.
